## Provenance of the artifact that trained run 2 (added 2026-08-24, AT:R70 CR196)

`train.jsonl` / `val.jsonl` are **gitignored** (126MB) — the repo carries the generators and this
manifest, not the corpus. That makes "which file trained this model" unanswerable from git alone, and
it bit us: the working copy on the Mac and the copy on alpha-spark had drifted to different row counts
(20,029 vs 20,021) with no way to tell which the model saw.

The corpus that run 2 actually trained on, measured on alpha-spark:

| file | rows | md5 |
|---|---|---|
| `train.jsonl` | 20,021 | `ccdfade3df04501f5ea252bb36f0def3` |

Decontamination re-verified against **that** file, not the local copy: 0 of the 468 prompts in
`eval/surfaces/surface_prompts.jsonl` appear in it verbatim.

Rule going forward: any claim about the training corpus is checked against the copy on the training
box and stamped with its md5 here. A decontamination result computed against a local working copy is
evidence about the working copy, not about the model.
